changes.before: Branch-3 reports conditional analytic readout ratios favouring integration at some couplings and endpoints at others. Those ratios exclude optimisation and circuit costs, and their underlying cost-result file is omitted from this transport. No total-cost saving is established.
changes.after: The branch-3 readout analysis is conditional on its ideal measurement protocol and excludes optimisation and circuit costs. Its underlying cost-result file was omitted from the original editorial transport. No total-cost saving is established.
